opportunities.name: Finite Meep Volley
opportunities.objective: Measure three attacks and another volley after natural refill.
opportunities.mechanic: P supplies AP magic damage on attacks, with chime-gated slow/cone effects. Hail of Blades/Nashor can spend stored meeps quickly; Q enables one Lich Bane attack. Cosmic follows magic hits without assuming extra meeps from repeated on-hits.
opportunities.requiredState: Record chimes and stored meeps plus farmed/support income.
opportunities.failure: Meep stock ends before attack-speed investment pays.
opportunities.test: Measure three attacks and another volley after natural refill; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: On-hit repetition does not create or duplicate meeps.

opportunities.name: Mature Shrine Charges
opportunities.objective: Compare charged shrine heal and Helia storage before collection.
opportunities.mechanic: W matures after five seconds from 0.4 AP to 0.7 AP healing. Q/meep champion damage may store Helia charges before an ally collects W; Staff rewards allied healing and Redemption can be timed around R stasis.
opportunities.requiredState: Mature W and damage a champion before ally collection.
opportunities.failure: Enemies destroy W or allies collect before maturation.
opportunities.test: Compare charged shrine heal and Helia storage before collection; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R stasis is not a heal trigger.

ruledOut.reason: R has stasis and no damage ratio.

unknowns: Meep recharge/chime thresholds are runtime tokens; remote shrine Helia trigger ownership needs a log.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.

builds.name: Finite Meep Volley
builds.summary: Measure three attacks and another volley after natural refill.
builds.goal: Measure three attacks and another volley after natural refill.
builds.hypothesis: P supplies AP magic damage on attacks, with chime-gated slow/cone effects. Hail of Blades/Nashor can spend stored meeps quickly; Q enables one Lich Bane attack. Cosmic follows magic hits without assuming extra meeps from repeated on-hits.
testPlan: Required state: Record chimes and stored meeps plus farmed/support income.
Measure three attacks and another volley after natural refill; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Meep stock ends before attack-speed investment pays.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: On-hit repetition does not create or duplicate meeps.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
